description: Save the item selector and fields you chose for a page as site/intent, then compile an HTTP recipe from them. Saving the same site/intent again replaces it. Check the returned sample against the page yourself.

fields.description: field name to selector relative to the item; "a@href" reads an attribute, "" reads the item text

id.description: the entity id, when the saved URL carried one

page.description: the page number, when the saved URL carried one

query.description: the search term, when the saved URL carried one

site.description: a name for the site, such as hn

skipSemanticVerification.description: skip the extra probe requests; the contract stays required and reads back as untested

url.description: the page, with any query/id/page value written into it

name: save
